notes.title: Pre-Multiplayer Patch
notes.notes:
Fixes all known single player bugs, including;
Bonus Levels not loading correctly
Fixed power-ups
Fixed Bullet collision on chance of passing through wall
Next update we'll be adding multiplayer for free in the game, stay tuned til then!
